results.title: As a doctor in Congress, I’m protecting families from drug middlemen

results.title: BiH aligns with EU restrictive measures in fight against terrorism
results.description: BRUSSELS, August 18 (FENA) – Bosnia and Herzegovina has aligned itself with the decision of the Council of the European Union regarding restrictive measures against individuals, groups, and entities involved in terrorist acts, according to a statement by EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, Kaja Kallas.

results.title: Three-day RSS coordination meeting to discuss demographic imbalance, youth de-addiction
results.description: Key functionaries from 32 Sangh-inspired organisations will participate in the meeting. RSS Sarsanghchalak Mohan Bhagwat, Sarkaryavah Dattatreya Hosabale, Sah-Sarkaryavahs, and other central office-bearers will also attend.
